description: This file defines the APIException class used within the OpenMRS API infrastructure. It extends RuntimeException and provides multiple constructors for error messaging and exception chaining, facilitating uniform error handling in the project.

classes.name: APIException
classes.description: A runtime exception class representing fatal errors within the OpenMRS API infrastructure. Provides multiple constructors for detailed error messages and exception chaining.

methods.name: APIException()
methods.description: Default constructor, not recommended for use; creates an APIException with no specific message.

methods.name: APIException(String message)
methods.description: Creates an APIException with a helpful message for the end user.

methods.name: APIException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Creates an APIException with a message and a parent cause exception.

methods.name: APIException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Creates an APIException by chaining a parent cause exception.

methods.name: APIException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Creates an APIException with a message retrieved from the message source service using the provided key and parameters.

methods.name: APIException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Creates an APIException with a message from the message source and chains a parent cause exception.
